title: pyrola asarifolia subsp. bracteata
intro: Pyrola asarifolia subsp. bracteata, commonly known as Western Wintergreen, is a plant species belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae) and is native to the Pacific coastal regions of North America. Western Wintergreen is used for its medicinal properties, particularly in reducing inflammation and relieving pain, attributed to its health benefits of acting as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Western Wintergreen include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Western Wintergreen include methyl salicylate, salicin, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
